title: Inference Roadmap Spotlight: Tactical Asks & Risk Lattice (Monthly Exec Readout)
creator: Liam O'Connor
description: Prepare a concise monthly executive spotlight packet focused on near-term tactical asks for inference economics and a risk lattice that maps technical risks to customer/financial impact. Packet will be used in the monthly exec readout and by GTM/sales for stakeholder alignment. Includes 1-page heatmap, three prioritized asks with resource breakdowns, contingency lanes, and explicit measurement criteria tied to OKRs.
acceptance_criteria: One-page executive packet produced and approved by ENG/Prod/Finance
Three tactical asks scoped to < 8 weeks of engineering effort each or an equivalent budget ask
Risk lattice visual that ties risk severity (probability x impact) to mitigation lanes and estimated residual cost
OKR mapping: each ask mapped to specific OKR key results with baseline and target metrics
All links (Confluence, PRs, dashboards) included and validated for access by execs
updates: 2026-03-10: Kickoff — aligned on scope (tactical asks + risk lattice). Confirmed audience: CEO, CFO, VP Eng, head of Sales.
2026-03-11: Draft heatmap created (concurrency vs unit-cost vs model-quality). Requested perf bucket numbers from Runtime team.
2026-03-12: Finance provided run-rate sensitivity model. Drafted two budget ask scenarios (conservative & accelerated).
2026-03-13: Design iterated on visual language for risk lattice; ENG provided initial effort estimates for three asks. Feedback: call out rollback and fallback costs explicitly.
2026-03-14: Internal review with VP Eng and Head of Finance. Action: tighten ask #2 to a staged pilot with canary gates. Marking document In Review.
review_feedback: VP Eng (Maya Chen): prefer staging ask #2 (pilot -> scale) and include rollback hours per region
Finance (Carlos Jimenez): request sensitivity table with 3 scenarios and explicit delta to cash runway
Sales (Nora Patel): ask #1 should include customer beta list and expected ARR impact range
decisions: Scope narrowed to three tactical asks: (1) KV-cache prefix sharing pilot, (2) adaptive batching autoscaler, (3) low-precision quantized runtime for 2 model families.
Ask #2 to be run as a region-limited pilot for 6 weeks before cross-region rollout
Release callout set to runtime-1.22 for tracking; canary metrics will be attached to console-2026.03
next_steps: Finalize one-page packet and visual risk lattice by 2026-03-17
Attach finalized effort estimates and budget ask (Finance sign-off) by 2026-03-18
Dry run with CEO/CFO scheduled 2026-03-19 morning
Publish packet to exec drive and send pre-read to attendees 48h before readout
